item.title: Morning brief, Friday November 27
item.description: Good morning, Sydney, and happy Black Friday. Before you open Instagram or TikTok, check in with yourself: did you get footage from F1 in Vegas or from Thanksgiving in the mountains? If the Vegas recap isn't up yet, this slow morning is the perfect time. Edit it, post it, then spend about thirty minutes replying to comments and messages. Today's one big thing is posting that F1 recap. Beyond that, keep it light. Make sure someone can grab your skirt delivery at home today, glance at your ShopGoodwill orders, and accept Gabe's lease invite when you have a second. Your calendar is clear today, so take your walk and coffee whenever it feels good. In Granby it's partly sunny with a high near forty six, but very windy, with gusts up to forty miles an hour. Snow showers start late tonight, with one to three inches on Saturday, so do any driving today. No flights today. Enjoy the slow day.
